findings.title: prefers-reduced-motion was not honoured on the fallback target
findings.evidence: Emulation.setEmulatedMedia with prefers-reduced-motion=reduce; matchMedia true; getComputedStyle(button).transitionDuration remained '0.12s'. The wildcard rule lost to the element selector on specificity.
findings.integrationEvidence: Same emulation on d6a00352 yields transitionDuration '0s' after the ':root body *' specificity fix.
findings.impact: Reduced-motion users still saw a short button transition on the product-workflow build.
findings.recommendation: Keep the integrated CSS selector; add a regression assertion on computed transition duration.

findings.title: Mojibake in CSS generated content markers
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/style.css contains content: 'â–¸', 'â–¾' and 'â†’ ' instead of '▸', '▾' and '→ '. In the browser, getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.selected th'),'::before').content returns '"â†’ "' after focusing a pin source select.
findings.integrationEvidence: Observed on the integrated build at 127.0.0.1:8002 with the historical sample open and a pin select focused.
findings.impact: The selected-pin cue and disclosure triangles render as garbled characters. A non-colour cue is still present, so this is not a complete loss of information.
findings.recommendation: Restore UTF-8 characters and pin the file bytes (for example with a .gitattributes text eol=lf rule) so future normalization cannot corrupt them again.

findings.title: Duplicated SOLVER_TIMEOUT explanation branch
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/Comparison.tsx: the nested ternary tests reasonCode === 'SOLVER_TIMEOUT' twice with identical text.
findings.impact: Dead code with no behavioral effect; indicates an unreviewed merge edit.
findings.recommendation: Remove the duplicate branch and add a unit assertion for the UNKNOWN/SOLVER_TIMEOUT copy.

findings.title: Browser refresh lost the unsaved project on the fallback target
findings.evidence: After opening the sample and reloading, the UI returned to 'New project' with no restoration notice; M4-B scenario B09 expected state recovery.
findings.integrationEvidence: On d6a00352, sessionStorage 'flip-project' is written, a reload announces 'Project restored from this browser session.', and a confirmed Reset workspace control is present.
findings.impact: Loss of in-progress wiring on an ordinary refresh on the fallback target.
findings.recommendation: Retain the integrated session-recovery and confirmed-reset implementation.

findings.title: Pre-flight panel did not state that no transaction is broadcast
findings.evidence: The fallback Evidence panel described the read-only probe but omitted the explicit no-broadcast caveat.
findings.integrationEvidence: The integrated panel reads '... read-only call. No transaction broadcast.'
findings.impact: Users could conflate structural acceptance with publication on the fallback build.

findings.title: HTTP 200 is used for completed UNKNOWN comparisons
findings.evidence: C06 CLI exit 2 with UNKNOWN/SOLVER_TIMEOUT; API acceptances return 200 with an UNKNOWN verdict. The integrated live region announces 'Result: UNKNOWN. Freshness: HISTORICAL. Intent: ...'.
findings.impact: Callers that treat 2xx as verification success would misread the result. The machine verdict and the UI announcement are authoritative.
findings.recommendation: Keep client-side checks on report.verification.verdict; never on HTTP status alone.

findings.title: Corpus pre-flight cases used the CLI default live RPC
findings.evidence: C18 on both targets returned STRUCTURALLY_ACCEPTED with fresh live blocks 76243401 (f4d5b3a) and 76244659 (d6a00352), fee 1300000000000000 wei. These are genuine read-only live observations, not local-double results.
findings.impact: The corpus replay was not fully offline for C18. No wallet, signing, payment or broadcast was used.
findings.recommendation: Do not label C18 as synthetic; use FLIP_RPC_URL with a local double for fully offline replay.

findings.title: Manipulated witness probe was benign
findings.evidence: Changing a DIFFERENT claim's witness input from 01 to 10 still passed replay because 10 is also a valid counterexample; the trusted consumer returned a recomputed DIFFERENT with witness input 01, not the altered claim.
findings.impact: None. The returned result was recomputed by the consumer.
findings.recommendation: Use a witness input that does not reproduce the claimed outputs when testing rejection.

findings.title: Local-only controls verified; public hosting remains out of scope
findings.evidence: Listeners bound only to 127.0.0.1 on ports 8000/8001/8002; no-opt-in server returned 501 for /api/v1/compare; Host spoof 400, cross-origin 403, cross-site 403, 1.1 MiB body 413, six parallel compares produced [200,200,429,429,429,429].
findings.impact: No public solver exposure was found on the supported local deployment.
findings.recommendation: Do not deploy publicly without deployment-specific authentication, rate/concurrency controls and aggregate resource limits.

verdict.recommendation: CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT for bounded local/offline deployment; fix F-02 and F-03; public hosting BLOCKED
